Cruising down the road with your favorite music on, but always in for a friendly chat at the door? That's exactly what your day looks like as an Albert Heijn delivery driver! 
You get to enjoy some peaceful "me-time" behind the wheel. But once you arrive at the customer's doorstep? It's time for a warm smile and a quick, happy chat!

 what we offer 
 Bring a friend and get € 200!

 who you are 
As a delivery driver at Albert Heijn, you are the hero who delivers groceries right to the customer's door. You are physically fit and can easily lift crates up to 15 kilos. You recognize yourself in the following: - You speak Dutch or English; - You have transportation to get to Nijverheidsweg 73A in Amersfoort; - You have a valid B driving license (stick shift).

You start your day with a quick check of the van. After that you pick up your delivery routes of the day. Of you go! From city streets to hidden roads in small villages.
